lines.text: Which one do you want to see?

“Here I am at the Seafoam Islands in my search
for Pokémon I’ve never seen before!\c
“I came across some rapids underground that
were too fast to swim across.\c
“I was exploring that area when, suddenly, I was
hit by a blast of freezing cold.\c
“It was as if I was stuck in a blizzard!
It got so cold, I began to black out.\c
“As my consciousness faded, I saw a pair of shiny
wings over the waves.\c
“...Could that have been the Legendary
Pokémon Articuno?!\c
“When I came to, I was lying on the ground
outside of the cave, for some reason...\c
“I need to practice my swimming so that next
time I can capture Articuno for sure!”

“Here I am at the abandoned Power Plant in my
search for Pokémon I’ve never seen before!\c
“I had no idea you could reach this place
by swimming from that spot on Route 10.\c
“As I was exploring, one of the Poké Balls lying
around suddenly attacked me!\c
“It made a huge explosion and knocked me out!\c
“But I do remember seeing some jagged-looking
wings as I blacked out.\c
“...Could that have been the Legendary
Pokémon Zapdos?!\c
“When I came to, I found myself lying outside
the Power Plant...\c
“As soon as I become able to withstand those
explosions, I’m going back to catch Zapdos!”

“Here I am at Victory Road in my search for
Pokémon I’ve never seen before!\c
“It seems you can’t get very far without doing
something about the stone walls in the way.\c
“As I was exploring the cave, I saw the most
beautiful Pokémon.\c
“It was so beautiful that I got overwhelmed and
passed out.\c
“As I did, though, I saw it flap its brightly
burning wings.\c
“...Could that have been the Legendary
Pokémon Moltres?!\c
“When I came to, I was all alone...\c
“Next time, I’ve got to stay conscious so I
can capture Moltres for sure!”
